input_text:
15 Apr 2020
                   Turkish mobile operator Turkcell has selected US-based Affirmed Networks’ Service Orchestration & Automation platform and its virtualised Wi-Fi gateway ‘to profitably introduce new revenue-generating services faster and deliver seamless connectivity to customers’. Affirmed CTO Ron Parker said: ‘Implementing this platform, combined with our Wi-Fi solution, will allow Turkcell to create new network slices, help their enterprise customers to on-board and provision new customer premise equipment and enable new subscriber services to be deployed quickly, seamlessly and more reliably.’
 In Q1 2019 Turkcell and Affirmed completed the implementation of a single, unified Network Function Virtualisation (NFV) infrastructure, and Turkcell has now virtualised 60% of its mobile core services on its telco cloud, which features 20 unique virtualised network functions (VNFs), and is on target to meet its 75% goal by the end of 2020.

final_outline:
# Turkcell Partners with Affirmed Networks for Service Automation

Turkcell is enhancing its service offerings through a partnership with Affirmed Networks.

## Partnership Overview
- **Date of Announcement:** 15 Apr 2020
- **Partnering Companies:** Turkcell (Turkey) and Affirmed Networks (USA)
- **Platform Selected:** Affirmed Networks’ Service Orchestration & Automation platform
- **Objective:** To introduce new revenue-generating services faster and improve customer connectivity.
- **CTO Statement:** Ron Parker emphasized the benefits of the platform for creating network slices and provisioning new customer equipment.

Turkcell aims to leverage this partnership to enhance service delivery and customer experience.

---

## Network Virtualization Progress
- **Previous Collaboration:** Turkcell and Affirmed completed a unified Network Function Virtualisation (NFV) infrastructure in Q1 2019.
- **Current Virtualization Status:** Turkcell has virtualized 60% of its mobile core services on its telco cloud.
- **Unique VNFs:** The infrastructure includes 20 unique virtualized network functions (VNFs).
- **Future Goal:** Turkcell aims to reach 75% virtualization by the end of 2020.

This progress highlights Turkcell's commitment to modernizing its network infrastructure.
